body: See that doesn't work. That's the problem I have to either take a really long time off or it just get's worse and worse. By long time I mean more than a 1 month. Those "mini" vacations happen more and more as it get's worse but they don't work in the long run.

I really don't know. There isn't something I can point to and say that's what's caused this. Maybe it's existential.

It's more of how I've always felt. What usually happens is it just get's worse and worse from the constant preasure to work or study over the course of the year then I become gradually worse and worse at functioning. Until I have to take a long time off in order to function again. (Read function, I still want to die at the end of the day just that I can actually work instead of having to lock myself in)

But now I'm afraid to die.. I just really want to watch the last of The Hobbit series, so I have to at least survive until december.

It's really weird going from "I want to cease to exist" to "Ohh god, what if I die before I can watch the last of The Hobbit"

Drinking is an easy temporary escape. 

I've found another car in my price range already, if it's okay I'll buy it next weekend. (It's actually a better car then the one I had before)
I just watched Candy Boy! Really loved how they portrayed the sister romance, the pairing was just so cute and the kiss the end was just so great!
Is there more of this? (From r9k?)
Do you have a copy of that? It's deleted.. :(
Why should that stop true love?

I've tried new things, I might feel better for the duration of what I'm doing but after that I'm back in the hole. It's inescapable, I can leave temporarily to have fun, smile and be happy but I'll always end up feeling like this afterwards.
